meta.title: MVP Review Fixes: Recursive orphan walk + test cleanup

architecture_notes: Add walkdir crate (small, well-tested by burntsushi; one transitive dep: same-file) — no point reinventing recursive directory walking.
Conservative recall: skip src/bin/ and test directories during recursive walk. False negatives over false positives.
All existing patterns (bon::Builder, serde camelCase/snake_case, #[must_use]) apply to any new code.
Fix directions should be applied in order — each fix modifies a separate file so order is independent.
known_pitfalls: WalkDir returns entries in arbitrary order (unsorted within each dir). The integration test assertion on orphan_file kind doesn't care about order, but if order ever matters, sort the result vec.

WalkDir::filter_entry predicate returns true to KEEP / yield the entry, false to skip it (and prune its subtree). Read the predicate before writing: the closure must evaluate to !is_skipped, not is_skipped.
Use WalkDir::new(src_dir).into_iter().filter_entry(|e| ...) to exclude bin/tests at entry level — more efficient than skipping inside the loop.
Workspace-relative paths must use strip_prefix(workspace_root) — walkdir entries have absolute paths.
The declared_files set contains workspace-relative paths — join segments from the original src_dir base.
Fix 2 (test cleanup) is in a different region of integration_test.rs than Fix 1 — no risk of merge conflict.
Do NOT use WalkDir::follow_links(true) — symlink loops would cause infinite traversal.

tasks.description: Remove the spurious `std::fs::write` call in `test_orphaned_module_serde_regression` that writes an empty Cargo.toml to src/Cargo.toml

changes.guidance: At line 594, remove the line: `std::fs::write(src.join("Cargo.toml").parent().unwrap().join("Cargo.toml"), "").ok();`. This is a leftover debug artifact. The test already writes a correct Cargo.toml at the root level (line 579). The src/Cargo.toml write is unnecessary and confusing.
